key.name: panel-position
key.description: Position of the media controls indicator in the panel (left, center, right)

key.name: panel-index
key.description: Index within the chosen panel area (-1 = automatic)

key.name: show-track-name
key.description: Display track title next to the panel icon while media is playing

key.name: show-artist
key.description: Append the artist name to the track title shown in the panel

key.name: separator-text
key.description: Text inserted between the track title and artist name in the panel label

key.name: panel-label-width
key.description: Visible pixel width of the scrolling track label in the top panel

key.name: enable-panel-scroll
key.description: Scroll the track/artist label in the top panel

key.name: scroll-speed
key.description: Speed of panel text scrolling: 1 = slowest, 10 = fastest

key.name: max-title-length
key.description: Maximum characters shown in the panel label when scrolling is disabled

key.name: panel-element-order
key.description: Comma-separated order of panel elements: icon, label, controls

key.name: panel-font-family
key.description: Font family for the panel track/artist label. Empty = inherit from shell theme.

key.name: panel-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for the panel track/artist label

key.name: panel-font-bold
key.description: Render the panel label text in bold weight

key.name: panel-font-color
key.description: CSS colour for the panel label text. Empty = inherit from shell theme.

key.name: panel-icon-size
key.description: Pixel size of the application icon shown in the top panel

key.name: popup-title-font-family
key.description: Font family for the track-title label in the popup player. Empty = inherit.

key.name: popup-title-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for the popup track-title

key.name: popup-title-font-bold
key.description: Render the popup title in bold weight

key.name: popup-title-font-color
key.description: CSS colour for the popup title. Empty = inherit from theme.

key.name: popup-artist-font-family
key.description: Font family for the artist-name label in the popup player. Empty = inherit.

key.name: popup-artist-font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for the popup artist label

key.name: popup-artist-font-bold
key.description: Render the popup artist label in bold weight

key.name: popup-artist-font-color
key.description: CSS colour for the popup artist label. Empty = inherit.

key.name: tab-icon-size
key.description: Icon size used in the multi-player switcher tabs

key.name: single-icon-size
key.description: Icon size used when only one player is active

key.name: popup-width
key.description: Width of the popup media-player panel in pixels

key.name: enable-title-scroll
key.description: Scroll long track titles inside the popup media player

key.name: title-scroll-speed
key.description: Speed of title scrolling in the popup: 1 = slowest, 10 = fastest

key.name: enable-artist-scroll
key.description: Scroll long artist names inside the popup media player

key.name: artist-scroll-speed
key.description: Speed of artist scrolling in the popup: 1 = slowest, 10 = fastest

key.name: info-align-center
key.description: When true the track title and artist are centred under the album art

key.name: popup-button-order
key.description: Comma-separated order of popup control buttons

key.name: vinyl-app-ids
key.description: List of desktop-entry IDs for which the rotating vinyl record effect is active

key.name: vinyl-app-disabled-ids
key.summary: Apps with vinyl effect explicitly disabled
key.description: List of desktop-entry IDs that have been explicitly disabled by the user

key.name: vinyl-app-instances
key.description: JSON-encoded list of player instance objects

key.name: immersive-cover
key.description: Use the album art as the full popup background instead of the square or vinyl cover

key.name: lyrics-gradient-background
key.description: In immersive mode, show a gradient taken from the cover colours behind the lyrics instead of the cover image

key.name: cover-cache-version
key.description: Bumped by the preferences window after the album art cache is cleared, so the popup fetches the current cover again

key.name: immersive-app-ids
key.description: Desktop-entry IDs that always use the immersive cover

key.name: immersive-app-disabled-ids
key.description: Desktop-entry IDs that never use the immersive cover

key.name: enable-album-art-rotation
key.description: Spin the album art as a vinyl record while music plays

key.name: album-art-rotation-speed
key.description: Seconds per full rotation: 5 = fastest, 60 = slowest

key.name: tonearm-parked-angle
key.description: Angle in degrees when music is paused or stopped

key.name: tonearm-playing-angle
key.description: Angle in degrees when music is actively playing

key.name: vinyl-click-count
key.description: Number of rapid clicks on album art to toggle the vinyl effect

key.name: lyrics-click-count
key.description: Number of rapid clicks on album art to open or close the lyrics panel

key.name: immersive-click-count
key.description: Number of rapid clicks on album art to switch immersive cover on or off for the current player

key.name: lyrics-font-family
key.description: Font family for the synced lyrics. Empty = use the system interface font.

key.name: enable-lyrics
key.description: Fetch and display time-synced lyrics from lrclib.net

key.name: hide-default-player
key.description: Hide the built-in GNOME Shell media player controls from the date/time menu

key.name: player-filter-mode
key.description: 0 = off, 1 = blacklist, 2 = whitelist

key.name: player-filter-list
key.description: Comma-separated list of MPRIS short names to include or exclude

key.name: progress-theme-id
key.description: ID of the active progress bar theme. Built-in values: default, zenitsu, sonic, nyancat, plasma, fire. User themes are loaded from ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/media-controller-themes/*.theme.js and their ID is the theme.id field declared inside the file.

key.name: progress-gif-enabled
key.summary: Enable animated GIF thumb on progress bar
key.description: When true, the progress bar thumb receives a GIF pixbuf passed to the theme's drawThumb function

key.name: progress-gif-path
key.summary: Path to the animated GIF used as the progress bar thumb
key.description: Absolute filesystem path to a .gif or .webp file. Empty = use the theme's built-in thumb.

key.name: progress-bar-use-system-color
key.summary: Use system theme colour for progress bar
key.description: When true, themes that support it will use the GNOME Shell accent colour

key.name: progress-bar-color
key.description: CSS colour string (hex, rgb, rgba) for the filled portion of the progress track

key.name: progress-use-native-slider
key.description: When true, the native GTK slider is used with the system theme colour instead of the custom Cairo-drawn theme
